_comment: Newest first. Rendered into changelog.html and changelog.xml by scripts/generate.mjs. type: new | improved | fixed. Links are site paths.

Animated gradient borders: three techniques compared, animated with @property

items.text: CSS clamp() generator: fluid font sizes and type scales, with a check that 200% browser zoom still works
